target_profile.description: Innovera is an AI-native decision intelligence platform. Its core premise is that AI and fast-moving markets expand options faster than leadership can judge them. Innovera builds digital twins of initiatives through specialized agents covering opportunity validation, market research, competitive analysis, product and technology, GTM, financials, talent, legal, and IP. The platform combines AI analysis with expert-in-the-loop validation, sells into corporate innovators, strategy teams, and executives, and substitutes for large consulting-team engagements delivered faster.
target_profile.audience: Corporate innovators, strategy teams, and executives
